Inglewood, California
  July 20, 2021

The City Council of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on Tuesday,
July 20, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Mayor Butts called the City Council into Closed Session at the hour of 1:00 p.m.
The City Clerk announced the presence of a quorum as follows:
  Present:  Mayor Butts, Council Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales
  and Faulk; and

  not in favor of adopting Resolution No. 21-107.

  2

  consider the adoption of a resolution adopting the City’s 2020 Urban Water Management
  Plan, and that notices were given in the time, form and manner as required by law, an
  affidavit was on file, and no communications were received.

  notification. The speaker requested new developments to provide residents with trees to

  information missing from the water plan.

  CALIFORNIA MAKING FINDINGS AND OVERRULING PROTESTS AND
  OBJECTIONS TO ITS INTENT TO ADOPT THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  2020 URBAN WATER MANAGEMENT PLAN.

  Noes: None.
